desc:
🎃 HALLUCINATION — HALLOWEEN UPDATE

👁 Are you sure you're awake?

You wake up in a place you don't recognize. Everything seems normal at first, but something feels wrong.

Rooms change when you're not looking. Hallways lead to impossible places. Doors take you somewhere you shouldn't be.

And something is watching you.

Welcome to HALLUCINATION, a psychological horror experience where reality slowly falls apart and nothing is ever what it seems.

🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE:
- Halloween Decorations
- New Halloween Dream Monster Skin
- Halloween Ambient & Atmosphere
- Bug Fixes & Improvements
- And much more!

👁 Question everything you see.
🚪 Explore unpredictable and constantly changing environments.
📼 Experience a disturbing analog horror atmosphere.
🫁 Hide, stay quiet, and control your breathing.
👤 The monster can hear your voice and react to your words.

⚠️ WARNING: This experience contains flashing lights, loud sounds, and intense horror elements.

🎧 Headphones recommended.
